sn28.4:1.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso sārīputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto
sn28.4:2.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn28.4:2.2: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso na evaṃ hoti
sn28.4:2.3: ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ catutthā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
sn28.4:2.4: tathā hi panāyasmato sārīputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā
sn28.4:2.5: tasmā āyasmato sārīputtassa na evaṃ hoti
sn28.4:2.6: ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ catutthā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
